description:
`email` delivers an email you send to the UnitySVC SMTP gateway to your own verified email address — the address of the account you're acting as — plus the one additional email service you've set as your email preference, such as `smtp-relay` with your own server or an enrolled `smtp-relay`. You never name the recipient: whatever `To`, `Cc` or `Bcc` the message carries, delivery goes only to those destinations.

Use `email` to receive reports, receipts and documents as real email, with your formatting and attachments intact. It is separate from `notify`, which delivers short notifications through the API gateway.
name: email

payout_price.description: No platform commission — delivers to the caller's own mailbox and configured email service

summary: Send an email to the UnitySVC SMTP gateway and it is delivered to your own verified address, plus the email service you've set as your preference — no recipient to specify.
